clue.text: Politically correct steps to take

definitions.meaning: in keeping with a nation's founding law, legitimate
a health walk, a stroll taken for exercise

explanation.surface: Someone asks which moves would be politically proper to make.
explanation.definitionFit: Constitutional means lawful under a state's founding rules, and as a noun a constitutional is a brisk walk taken for health.

clue.text: It's poor relief, be cautious about it

indicators.note: about means going round, so the word for cautious wraps the other piece

parts.note: to be chary is to be cautious or wary
taken as written

explanation.surface: A warning that handouts to the poor deserve some caution.
explanation.definitionFit: Charity is aid given to the needy, the old sense of relief for paupers.

clue.text: Gamble on race-a chance to win lots of money

parts.note: the Grand National, Britain's famous steeplechase horse race, is known simply as the National

parts.words: a chance to win lots of money
parts.note: a draw of tickets for prizes, a game of chance

explanation.surface: A bet on a horse race seen as a shot at a fortune.
explanation.walkthrough: The Grand National is the big annual British steeplechase at Aintree, so 'race' gives NATIONAL.
explanation.definitionFit: The UK's state-run draw is a form of gambling that sells tickets for big prizes.

clue.text: Take a sample of the water at Southampton

definitions.meaning: to examine or try something out
the river reaching the sea at the port of Southampton, in Hampshire

explanation.surface: Someone collects a specimen of the river or sea water at a port.
explanation.definitionFit: To test is to try out a sample, and the Test is the river that flows into Southampton Water on England's south coast.

clue.text: The name given to a real sport!

definitions.text: The name given to a real sport!

parts.words: The name given to a real sport!
parts.note: the indoor court game from medieval times is called real, or royal, followed by this word; read straight it praises a game as genuine

explanation.surface: An exclamation that this pastime truly counts as a sport.
explanation.walkthrough: Real tennis is the old indoor court game from which lawn tennis grew; 'real' looks like 'genuine' but is part of the game's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Racket sport played over a net, also the second word in the historic game real tennis.

clue.text: It is difficult being so sensitive

definitions.meaning: easily set laughing or squirming by a light touch

explanation.surface: A remark that a person's touchiness makes things hard.
explanation.definitionFit: A ticklish problem is tricky and delicate, and a ticklish person reacts sharply to light touch.

clue.text: What you do when you half wake up?

definitions.text: What you do when you half wake up?

parts.words: What you do when you half wake up?
parts.note: half of waking taken literally: only one of a pair of eyelids is raised

explanation.surface: A question about the drowsy moment of half-waking.
explanation.definitionFit: Raising a single eyelid is the picture of being barely conscious, half awake.

clue.text: A spot of publicity

parts.note: spot read as a place rather than a little bit: a location set aside for promotion

explanation.surface: A small dose of promotion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A spot of' looks like 'a little', but spot means a place: a location used for ads.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoarding location or slot where promotional material is displayed is a place for publicity.

clue.text: Responsible for a convict getting privileges

definitions.meaning: a well-behaved prisoner given extra freedom and duties

explanation.surface: A prisoner earns perks for being dependable.
explanation.definitionFit: Trusty means reliable, and in prisons a trusty is an inmate granted special freedoms for good behaviour.

clue.text: Painting for example is one article made by a craftsman

parts.note: painting is one kind of art
taken as written
an is the indefinite article, meaning one

explanation.surface: A claim that a painting is one more object produced by a skilled maker.
explanation.definitionFit: An artisan is a skilled manual worker who makes things by hand.

clue.text: A butcher may use it to cut credit without permission

definitions.text: A butcher may use it to cut

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the credit letters sit around the other piece

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit
leave means permission, as in leave to go

explanation.surface: A butcher slashes someone's credit without being allowed to.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking', but here it has its old sense of outside, so the credit abbreviation goes round the word for permission.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy broad-bladed chopper is the meat trade's tool for hacking through bone.

clue.text: It's very hard, but laundry maids do it

definitions.meaning: firm and unyielding like the metal
pressing creases out of washed linen

explanation.surface: Laundry work is said to be tough, yet the maids manage it.
explanation.definitionFit: The metal stands for hardness (an iron will), and pressing clothes flat with a hot appliance is what laundresses do.

clue.text: Advertising account presentation to groups of directors

parts.note: a bill is an account presented for payment
boards are the bodies of directors running companies

explanation.surface: An ad agency pitches its campaign to company boardrooms.
explanation.definitionFit: Large outdoor hoardings are a medium for promotion, so they stand for advertising.

clue.text: Tender name, perhaps

parts.note: tender read as affectionate rather than an offer or bid: a loving pet word such as darling

explanation.surface: Possibly the name of a bid or offer submitted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tender' looks like a business bid but means affectionate; 'perhaps' marks a loving pet name as one example.
explanation.definitionFit: Words like darling or sweetheart are affectionate terms used in place of a name.

clue.text: Wishes to take time with extreme points

parts.note: a year is a period of time
N and S, north and south, are the compass extremes, the poles

explanation.surface: Someone hopes to spend time at the far ends of the earth.
explanation.definitionFit: To yearn is to long for something, so the verb matches wishes.

clue.text: In a way it repays harshness

indicators.note: in a way means after a fashion, so these letters are arranged differently

explanation.surface: Being harsh is said to pay back somehow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In a way' signals rearranging the letters of 'it repays'.
explanation.definitionFit: Asperity is roughness of manner or tone, a synonym of severity.

clue.text: Twice as expensive? Oh my!

indicators.note: twice as asks for the same word to appear two times in a row

parts.note: dear means costly

explanation.surface: Shock at a price that has doubled.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation of dismay or surprise, a mild oath.

clue.text: One is convinced there's some sort of evil in drink

indicators.note: in places the shuffled letters inside the word for drink

parts.note: beer is an alcoholic drink

indicators.note: some sort of means a version of, so the letters of evil are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is sure there is wickedness lurking in alcohol.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some sort of' calls for the letters of evil to be rearranged, and 'in' places the result inside the word for a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A person of faith is someone who is sure of a creed.

clue.text: Calls for a doctor, for example

definitions.text: Calls for a doctor, for example

parts.words: Calls for a doctor, for example
parts.note: calls read as electronic signals from a pager summoning a medic on duty

explanation.surface: Patients summoning a physician.
explanation.definitionFit: Short electronic tones from a pager alert hospital staff that they are wanted.

clue.text: Key member of the office staff

definitions.text: Key member of the office staff

parts.words: Key member of the office staff
parts.note: key read as a keyboard key rather than important: a worker who presses keys

explanation.surface: An essential employee in an office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Key' looks like 'important' but means keyboard keys.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone employed to produce documents on a keyboard.

clue.text: Catty female

parts.note: catty read literally as feline rather than spiteful

explanation.surface: A spiteful woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Catty' looks like 'spiteful', but here it means of the cat family.
explanation.definitionFit: The female of a big striped cat is literally a feline woman of the species.

clue.text: A maths formula which may leave one breathless

indicators.note: a formula reworks things, so the letters are set out in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A tough mathematical formula that leaves the student gasping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'formula' signals rearranging the letters of 'A maths'.
explanation.definitionFit: A respiratory condition causing wheezing and shortness of breath.

clue.text: Get in there and purchase-that's business

parts.note: to enter is to get in
purchase in its sense of leverage or grip; to prise is to force open with leverage

explanation.surface: Advice to go in and buy, because that is commerce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'purchase' looks like buying but here means leverage, the grip that PRISE gives.
explanation.definitionFit: An enterprise is a company or commercial venture.

clue.text: Eager to go back after a key

indicators.note: after puts the turned word behind the earlier pieces

parts.note: G is a musical key

indicators.note: back signals the word go is read in reverse

explanation.surface: Someone keen to return after finding a key.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns the word go around, and 'after' puts it behind A and the musical key letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Agog means excited and eagerly expectant.

clue.text: Not a man — American name

indicators.note: not signals that letters are taken away from the following word

parts.note: these letters are removed in order from the word American

explanation.surface: A forename that is not purely from the United States.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove A, M, A, N, in order, from AMERICAN and four letters remain.
explanation.definitionFit: A common male given name, a Scandinavian first name.

clue.text: Quietly withdraw and go before the others

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical abbreviation for quietly
to recede is to move back or withdraw

explanation.surface: Someone slips away quietly and leaves ahead of the group.
explanation.definitionFit: To come or go ahead of others in time or order.

clue.text: Hire one for the female lead

annotationWithheld.why: Hire one for the female lead: the letters of 'Hire one' are an anagram of the answer, but no clue word signals the rearrangement, so the clue as held looks short of an indicator
annotationWithheld.clue: Hire one for the female lead

clue.text: Hunters after natives

parts.note: natives read as farmed shellfish of British beds rather than local people: birds that prey on bivalves

explanation.surface: Hunters pursuing indigenous people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'natives' is the trade name for British oysters, not local people; the hunters are shore birds.
explanation.definitionFit: Black-and-white shore birds feeding on shellfish such as mussels and bivalves.
